name: Nova Ltd.
sector: Technology / Semiconductor metrology & process control equipment
moat_justification: Moderate-strong metrology franchise: tool-of-record positions at all four GAA players, #2 share (~25%) in film/CD metrology with ~400bp of share gains in 2025, gross margins held at 55.5-57.6% across FY2021-25 and roic_proxy of 18.1-33.8% over FY2020-25 - above the cost of capital through the FY2023 down year as well as the upcycle. Capped at 6, not 7+: ROIC has drifted from the high-20s to ~20%, Nova is a niche player against KLA/Applied Materials scale, demand is geared to a handful of customers' capex cycles, and there is no network effect or majority-recurring revenue. A 6 gives CAP 9.8 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override

Nova has no ADS program: the Nasdaq-traded security IS the ordinary share.) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

one_liner: Quality metrology franchise, moat 6/10 - but at $321.20 the price pre-pays more than the bull case: weighted IRR 7.9%, weighted IV@15% $118.29 on the corrected base of $5.84/share, and even the super-bull scenario (12.8% IRR, IV@15% $248.85) does not clear 15%; it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$118.
moat_for: Tool-of-record qualification stickiness - Nova is a partner for all four GAA players and its WMC platform was selected as tool of record by a leading global foundry for advanced-packaging flows (Q2 2026 reporting); qualified metrology tools are embedded in fab process flows and are costly to displace

Returns through a cycle: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json stayed 18.1-33.8% over FY2020-25 (27.6% FY2021, 27.9% FY2022, 18.1% in the FY2023 down year, 20.7% FY2024, 19.6% FY2025) - well above the cost of capital in every year including the downturn

Pricing power / margin durability: gross margin held 55.5-57.6% in every year FY2021-25 (fundamentals.json) and 57% GAAP in Q2 2026, through both the FY2023 revenue decline and the current AI-led upcycle
Share gains in its niches: ascent to #2 in film and critical-dimension metrology at roughly 25% market share, gaining about 400bp in 2025 (company/analyst reporting cited in analysis.md)
Diversified metrology portfolio - dimensional, materials and chemical metrology plus a recurring services layer (services $102.5M in H1 2026), broadening beyond any single measurement step
moat_against: Niche scale against far larger process-control rivals - KLA dominates process control and Applied Materials/ASML outspend Nova on R&D; Nova is #2 in its film/CD niches at roughly 25% share

Semiconductor capex cyclicality - revenue fell in FY2023 and corrected OE/share swung from $2.74 in FY2023 to $6.00 in FY2024 and $5.84 in FY2025 (financials_history.csv totals on the thousands-corrected share scale); customer capex pauses hit tool orders directly
Customer concentration in a handful of leading foundry, logic and memory makers whose GAA/packaging roadmaps set Nova's demand

ROIC is drifting down, not up: roic_proxy 27.6-27.9% in FY2021-22 to 18.1-20.7% in FY2023-25 (fundamentals.json) as the equity base compounds and acquisitions (Sentronics, closed early 2025) add goodwill/intangibles
Packaging inspection/metrology rivals (Onto Innovation, Camtek) attack the advanced-packaging growth leg from adjacent positions
